## Mapping Decisions

- **Type discriminator on `FEATURES.RECORD_TYPE`.** No record states both name kinds. Organization aliases are NAME_ORG with
  NAME_TYPE AKA (e.g. "Universal Exports, USA" / AKA "Universal Exports").
- **INCORPORATED → REGISTRATION_DATE** (confidence 0.9). The catalog defines REGISTRATION_DATE as an organization's
  registration or incorporation date; the field is present only on the 6 organizations; the year is emitted as given
  (partial dates accepted). Alternative rejected: payload.
- **REGISTRY_ROLE is payload.** The relationships themselves are carried by REL_POINTER_ROLE.
- **Relationship network (domain REFERENCE), kept as stated:** anchors on 2012 (key 2011), 2041, 2071, 2074; pointers
  from owners (Owns 40-100%), officers (President, Principal) and subsidiaries (Global Parent → 2074). The anchor key on
  2012 is 2011, not its own RECORD_ID; the pointers that target it use 2011, so the links are consistent.
- **Cross-source shared-feature check:** REGISTRATION_DATE, LEI_NUMBER, EMPLOYER and NATIONAL_ID (UEN) appear in no
  earlier source; the other features share attribute names and quantities with earlier sources. No pairs to ask.

## Quality Notes

- Mapped-output quality 67.8 (completeness 58.3, format consistency 87.9, duplicate keys 0%). The bootcamper chose to
  move on below 70 at both the Phase 1 and the mapping gate.
- Coverage: NAME 100%, ADDRESS 73%, REL_POINTER 64%, EMPLOYER 41%, PHONE 36%, REGISTRATION_DATE 27% (all orgs),
  REL_ANCHOR 18%, TAX_ID 18%, EMAIL 18%, DOB 9%, LEI 9%, NATIONAL_ID 9%.
- Name variants kept verbatim for Senzing to weigh: Keeley Jones / "Jones, Kaylee", Kristen Salinger / "Salenger, Kristin",
  Rosemay A Thomas / Rosemary A Thomas, Anastassia Alexopoulos / "Alexopoulos, Nastassia".
- One email is in `Name<address>` form (`Nastassia<patak@universal.com>`), kept verbatim.
- Analyzer notices: TAX_ID_TYPE "custom" is a false positive (Entity Specification Feature: TAX_ID; installed 4.4.4 default
  configuration lists it); EMPLOYER uniqueness 33% is expected (9 people, 3 employers).
- Gates: analyzer exit 0; verbatim check passes; routing report drops nothing. Structural only; the semantic check is
